newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing Orient says H1 net up 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient says H1 net up 20 pct.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics (Group) Co Ltd expects its net profit to rise about 20 percent year-on-year in the first half of 1997, a senior company official said on Wednesday.
Net profits for first-half 1996 stood at about 55 million yuan, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The official did not clarify whether the figures were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
The company forecast net profits of at least 122.5 million yuan for 1997 under international standards, compared with 111 million yuan booked for 1996.

The firm had signed an agreement with a Taiwan-based firm to form a venture with a total investment of 700 million yuan to make colour television tubes, and terminals for multi-media computers, he said.
Beijing Orient would hold a 52 percent stake in the venture, with the rest held by the Taiwanese partner, he said, giving no further details.
He also said the company planned to make an initial public offering of A shares using proceeds to finance the television and terminal venture.
Beijing Orient, a maker of lamps and television components, listed 115 million B shares in Shenzhen last month.
